article_content: The sixth and final season of The Crown begins with a tragic event familiar to many—the fatal 1997 car accident of Princess Diana in Paris. The new season is released in two installments: the first four episodes debuted on Netflix on Nov. 16, and the remaining six will be available on Dec. 14. The initial episodes focus on Diana’s final days, portraying her last holiday with her sons aboard Mohamed al-Fayed's yacht and a budding romance with his son, Dodi Fayed. One standout moment occurs in episode three, which covers Diana and Dodi’s final day in Paris. The episode starts with Diana and Dodi on a yacht near Monte Carlo, but they cut their trip short due to persistent paparazzi. En route to London, Dodi decides they will stop in Paris, with encouragement from his father, intending to propose to Diana. They detour to Villa Windsor, purchased and renovated by Mohamed al-Fayed, causing Diana to miss a planned phone call to her sons. In Paris, the couple stays at the Ritz—also owned by Mohamed—where they face intense media scrutiny. The pressure causes tension, especially for Diana, who is eager to return to her sons. To avoid the press, Diana and Dodi dine privately in their suite and later leave through a back entrance, using their main car as a decoy. Taking an alternate route, they end up at the Pont de l’Alma tunnel, where the fatal accident occurs. The series takes creative liberties depicting Dodi’s proposal and Diana’s gentle rejection. The imagined conversation enables both characters to reflect on their lives and future, adding emotional depth given the tragic outcome. While the show speculates about these events, details of their final night remain unverified. In The Crown, Dodi attempts to propose, but Diana stops him, reasoning neither is ready for marriage. The show indicates Dodi acted under his father’s pressure. In reality, reports differ on the couple’s relationship status. Dodi was previously engaged to model Kelly Fisher, who learned of Dodi and Diana's relationship through media photos. Fisher reportedly sued Dodi for breach of contract, but dropped the lawsuit after the accident. The 'Dis-moi Oui' ring shown in The Crown was purchased by Dodi, widely speculated to be an engagement ring. Jeweler Alberto Repossi claimed Diana and Dodi picked out the ring together; others, including Ritz executive Claude Roulet, have disputed this account. Diana also had a gold Bulgari ring, reportedly a friendship ring from Dodi, according to her former butler Paul Burrell. Burrell wrote that Diana described her relationship with Dodi as a summer fling and denied engagement rumors. Mohamed al-Fayed maintained the couple was engaged and suggested Diana was pregnant, claiming a conspiracy led to their deaths—a theory discredited by several official inquests and family members. Diana’s brother, Earl Charles Spencer, and coroners dismissed the conspiracy and pregnancy claims, supported by forensic tests showing no pregnancy. The episode shows Diana prioritizing her sons, William and Harry, and her distress at missing a scheduled call due to travel delays. In real life, Diana spoke with her sons a few hours before her death, a call both princes have recalled with emotion and regret. According to Prince William and Prince Harry in interviews and memoirs, the trauma surrounding their mother's death deeply affected their memories of these final moments.

La nouvelle saison est diffusée en deux parties : les quatre premiers épisodes sont sortis sur Netflix le 16 novembre, et les six derniers seront disponibles le 14 décembre. Les premiers épisodes se concentrent sur les derniers jours de Diana, montrant ses vacances avec ses fils à bord du yacht de Mohamed al-Fayed et sa romance naissante avec son fils, Dodi Fayed. Un moment marquant survient dans le troisième épisode, qui revient sur le dernier jour de Diana et Dodi à Paris. En route pour Londres, Dodi décide de faire une halte à Paris, encouragé par son père, avec l’intention de demander Diana en mariage. Ils font un détour par la Villa Windsor, achetée et rénovée par Mohamed al-Fayed, ce qui fait rater à Diana un appel prévu à ses fils. À Paris, le couple séjourne au Ritz — également propriété de Mohamed — où ils subissent une forte pression médiatique. La pression engendre des tensions, surtout pour Diana, impatiente de retrouver ses fils. Pour éviter la presse, Diana et Dodi dînent dans leur suite et quittent l’hôtel par une entrée dérobée, leur voiture principale servant de leurre. En prenant un itinéraire alternatif, ils arrivent dans le tunnel du Pont de l’Alma, où survient le tragique accident. La série prend des libertés en montrant la demande en mariage de Dodi et le refus doux de Diana. Cette conversation imaginaire permet aux deux personnages de réfléchir sur leur vie et leur avenir, renforçant l’émotion du drame à venir. Bien que la série spécule sur ces événements, les détails de leur dernière nuit demeurent non vérifiés. Dans The Crown, Dodi tente de demander Diana en mariage, mais cette dernière le stoppe, estimant qu’aucun des deux n’est prêt. La série indique que Dodi était sous la pression de son père. En réalité, des versions divergentes existent sur le statut du couple. Dodi était auparavant fiancé au mannequin Kelly Fisher, qui a découvert la relation de Dodi avec Diana par les médias. Fisher aurait intenté un procès pour rupture de contrat, mais l’aurait abandonné après l’accident. La bague « Dis-moi Oui » montrée dans The Crown a été achetée par Dodi, et beaucoup pensent qu’il s’agissait d’une bague de fiançailles. Le joaillier Alberto Repossi a affirmé que Diana et Dodi ont choisi la bague ensemble ; cependant d’autres, comme Claude Roulet, un cadre du Ritz, mettent cette histoire en doute. Diana possédait également une bague Bulgari en or, considérée comme un anneau d’amitié de la part de Dodi selon son ancien majordome, Paul Burrell. Burrell écrit que Diana a décrit sa relation avec Dodi comme une amourette estivale et qu’elle niait les rumeurs de fiançailles. Mohamed al-Fayed a affirmé le contraire, suggérant que le couple était fiancé et que Diana était enceinte, soutenant une théorie du complot selon laquelle leur décès aurait été provoqué — théorie réfutée par plusieurs enquêtes officielles et les membres de la famille. Le frère de Diana, le comte Charles Spencer, ainsi que des médecins légistes, ont rejeté les rumeurs de complot et de grossesse, les analyses scientifiques attestant de l’absence de grossesse. L’épisode montre Diana donnant la priorité à ses fils, William et Harry, et son angoisse d’avoir manqué un appel prévu à cause des retards de voyage. En réalité, Diana a réellement parlé à ses fils quelques heures avant sa mort, un appel dont les deux princes se souviennent avec émotion et regret. Selon William et Harry, dans des interviews et mémoires, le traumatisme lié à la perte de leur mère a profondément marqué leurs souvenirs de ces derniers instants.

article_content: A mother is seeking legal action after claiming that doctors at Sunderland Royal Hospital wrongly advised her to terminate her pregnancy following a diagnosis that her baby was 'brain dead.' During her 24-week pregnancy scan, Sarah Hagan says she was told her child had 'no hope of survival.' She took medication to induce termination, but was later informed the doctors planned to deliver her baby. Ms Hagan, 38, from Farringdon, Sunderland, and her partner Darren Perry, 25, have begun legal proceedings against City Hospitals Sunderland. Hagan claims she was told her baby’s brain had not formed properly, that her only option was a termination, and that her child could be born with one eye. Aaron was born at 24 weeks, weighing 1lb 7oz, and has experienced a range of health problems, including chronic lung disease and a cyst on his brain. Hagan believes that if the pregnancy had continued longer, Aaron may not have faced these complications. She says his brain development is now normal for his age, despite the initial prognosis. After taking medications intended for termination, Hagan says another doctor decided to deliver Aaron. He was born breathing and moving, contrary to medical expectations. Hagan hopes her story will inform other mothers and prevent similar incidents. Sarah Hagan was supported by her mother, Val, during the process. She reports being told in a consultation that her baby’s brain had not developed and there was no chance of survival. She was offered the choice of taking medication or being sent to Newcastle’s Royal Victoria Infirmary for a fetal heart stop. After taking medication, Hagan returned to the hospital when it was not effective. She was examined by a different doctor, who consulted a neonatal specialist and decided to deliver the baby. Aaron required immediate medical intervention following his premature birth, including ventilation and treatment for an infection and heart condition. He spent nearly two months in a neonatal unit before his health improved. A spokesperson for Sunderland Royal Hospital stated, 'The Trust can confirm awareness of legal action being taken by Ms Hagan. It would be inappropriate to comment further at this time. The Trust recognizes this is a distressing time for all involved.'

Lors de son échographie à 24 semaines de grossesse, Sarah Hagan dit qu'on lui a annoncé que son enfant n'avait « aucun espoir de survie ». Elle a pris des médicaments pour provoquer une interruption de grossesse, mais a ensuite été informée que les médecins envisageaient d'accoucher le bébé. Mme Hagan, 38 ans, de Farringdon, Sunderland, et son partenaire Darren Perry, 25 ans, ont entamé une procédure judiciaire contre City Hospitals Sunderland. Hagan affirme qu'on lui a dit que le cerveau de son bébé ne s'était pas correctement formé, que la seule option était une interruption de grossesse et que son enfant pourrait naître avec un seul œil. Aaron est né à 24 semaines, pesant 1 lb 7 oz (environ 650 g), et a eu divers problèmes de santé, dont une maladie pulmonaire chronique et un kyste au cerveau. Hagan estime que si la grossesse avait pu se poursuivre plus longtemps, Aaron n'aurait peut-être pas eu ces complications. Elle affirme que le développement cérébral de son fils est maintenant normal pour son âge, malgré le premier pronostic. Après avoir pris les médicaments destinés à provoquer une interruption de grossesse, Hagan dit qu'un autre médecin a décidé de faire naître Aaron. Il est né en respirant et en bougeant, contrairement aux attentes médicales. Hagan souhaite que son histoire puisse informer d'autres mères et éviter de tels incidents. Sarah Hagan a été soutenue par sa mère, Val, pendant cette épreuve. Elle rapporte qu'on lui a annoncé, lors d'une consultation, que le cerveau de son bébé ne s'était pas développé et qu'il n'y avait aucun espoir de survie. On lui a proposé de prendre des médicaments ou d'être envoyée au Royal Victoria Infirmary de Newcastle pour un arrêt cardiaque fœtal. Après avoir pris les médicaments, Hagan est revenue à l'hôpital lorsqu'ils n'ont pas fonctionné. Elle a été examinée par un autre médecin, qui a consulté un spécialiste en néonatologie, puis a décidé de procéder à l'accouchement. Après la naissance prématurée d'Aaron, il a nécessité une intervention médicale immédiate, notamment une ventilation et un traitement pour une infection et des problèmes cardiaques. Il a passé près de deux mois dans une unité néonatale avant que son état ne s'améliore. Un porte-parole du Sunderland Royal Hospital a déclaré : « Le Trust confirme qu'il est au courant de la procédure judiciaire engagée par Mme Hagan. Il serait inapproprié de commenter davantage pour le moment. Le Trust reconnaît que la situation est éprouvante pour toutes les personnes concernées. »

article_content: A woman has pleaded not guilty to child neglect charges after a baby fell from a first-floor window in Rainham, Kent. On August 5, Karen Sennett, 31, was arrested following the fall of her 18-month-old daughter from an open window, during which the child struck an awning and then an elderly man before hitting the ground. Passersby, such as 18-year-old Becky Zacharow, quickly assisted the baby and remained with her until emergency services arrived. The girl was treated for cuts to her head and chest, initially thought to have a serious head injury, and was transported to King's College Hospital in London. She was later released from the hospital. Witnesses initially mistook the child for a doll until she began crying. Sennett denied the child neglect charge in Medway Magistrates' Court and has been released on bail, with a further court appearance scheduled for November 14 at Maidstone Crown Court.

Des passants, comme Becky Zacharow, 18 ans, sont rapidement intervenus pour lui porter secours et sont restés à ses côtés jusqu’à l’arrivée des secours. La fillette a été soignée pour des coupures à la tête et à la poitrine ; suspectée au départ d’avoir une blessure grave à la tête, elle a été transférée à l’hôpital King’s College de Londres, puis autorisée à sortir. Des témoins, qui avaient d’abord cru qu’il s’agissait d’une poupée, ont compris la situation lorsque la petite s’est mise à pleurer. Karen Sennett a nié l’accusation de négligence au tribunal de première instance de Medway et a été libérée sous caution. Sa prochaine comparution aura lieu le 14 novembre à la Crown Court de Maidstone.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) — British military officials stated Sunday that Prince William did not break any rules when he used a Royal Air Force Chinook helicopter to visit his girlfriend’s residence. Chinook helicopters are typically employed to transport troops and equipment in conflict zones. According to the News of the World tabloid, the prince, who is second in line to the British throne, landed a Chinook in a field adjacent to Kate Middleton’s house. The report indicated that this action sparked anger among some military personnel, who viewed it as a misuse of resources at a time when British forces are stretched thin in Iraq and Afghanistan. The Ministry of Defense explained that the event was part of a planned training exercise intended to teach Prince William how to fly helicopters in combat situations. In a statement, the Ministry said, 'Battlefield helicopter crews routinely practice landing in fields and confined spaces away from airfields as an essential part of their operational training. These vital skills are used daily in conflict zones such as Iraq and Afghanistan.' The Ministry added that, due to a shortage of suitable practice landing fields, the offer to land near Middleton’s home on April 3 was accepted. They emphasized that no one boarded or exited the aircraft, which was on the ground for just 20 seconds. Britain’s air forces have previously faced criticism for permitting William, 25, to fly a Chinook to a bachelor party, accompanied by his brother, Prince Harry. William, a second lieutenant in the British Army, recently graduated as a pilot after completing a detachment with the Royal Air Force.

An illuminated American flag, secured with duct tape, is affixed to the top of a tall pine tree in Idaho Panhandle National Forest, near milepost 27 along I-90 at Fourth of July Pass in northern Idaho. According to the U.S. Forest Service, the flag was likely put up about a month ago, but its position makes removal too dangerous. 'We have no idea how it got up there,' said Jay Kirchner, a spokesman for the Idaho Panhandle National Forest, in an interview with the Coeur d'Alene Press. 'It's at the very top of the tree, and it wouldn't support the weight of someone trying to reach it.' The flag becomes illuminated at night and is easily visible from the highway. Professional tree climbers were dispatched to remove the flag, but the height and the narrowness of the tree's upper section made retrieval too risky. 'It's just too dangerous. It's not worth the risk since it's not causing harm,' Kirchner explained. He added he would prefer the flag and light be removed eventually, remarking, 'We applaud and respect the display of patriotism, but it was done on public land, and we discourage people from installing displays on public property.'

In a separate incident, German artists Mattias Wermke, 35, and Mischa Leinkauf, 37, claimed responsibility for replacing the American flags atop the Brooklyn Bridge with white flags, into which they had hand-stitched stars and stripes. The artists have since returned the original American flags to U.S. embassy officials in Germany.

Selon le Service forestier des États-Unis, le drapeau aurait été installé il y a environ un mois, mais sa position rend tout retrait trop dangereux. « Nous n’avons aucune idée de comment il est arrivé là », a déclaré Jay Kirchner, porte-parole des forêts nationales de l’Idaho Panhandle, au journal Coeur d’Alene Press. « Il est tout en haut de l’arbre et il ne supporterait pas le poids de quelqu’un qui essaierait d’y monter. » Le drapeau est illuminé la nuit et est facilement visible depuis l’autoroute. article_content: The Detroit Tigers concluded the 2023 MLB season with a 78-84 record, their best performance since 2016. Much of their progress was driven by emerging young players. Outfielders Riley Greene and Spencer Torkelson showed they could become everyday contributors, while Kerry Carpenter and Matt Vierling displayed potential as solid regulars or primary backups. In the pitching department, starters Reese Olson and Matt Manning proved reliable, and relievers Jason Foley and Tyler Holton demonstrated both stamina and quality. Left-handed starter Tarik Skubal stood out as a major asset. Selected in the ninth round of the 2018 draft from the University of Seattle, Skubal impressed in the minors with 212 strikeouts and 41 walks over 145 innings, earning a top-five ranking among pitching prospects in at least one evaluation. He reached the majors in 2020 during the COVID-shortened season, posting an impressive strikeout rate, although his contact management needed improvement at that time. Over the next couple of years, Skubal made considerable progress in limiting quality contact. In 2022, as he approached league average in key metrics and posted a strong 'Tru' ERA, he suffered a flexor tendon injury that required surgery, sidelining him into 2023. After a successful recovery, Skubal returned with increased fastball velocity (up from 94.2 mph to 95.8 mph) and significantly improved his ground ball rate to 51.6%. He also developed an above-average pop-up rate, a trait of elite pitchers. Skubal refined his approach by cutting his fastball usage from over 60% to 36%, while adding a reliable sinker and improving his changeup. The main area where improvement is still needed is his slider, which has flashed potential but has not become a consistent weapon. Impressively, Skubal has transformed into a strong contact manager, finishing 2023 with an adjusted contact score of 75, surpassing even AL Contact Manager of the Year Pablo Lopez. His advanced pitching stats indicate that if he maintains at least average contact management, he can be a top-tier starter. If his improvement continues, Skubal could become a serious candidate for future Cy Young Awards.

article_content: When Governor Dauda Lawal took office in Zamfara State, he encountered a region struggling with insecurity, economic decline, and significant neglect in critical areas such as education and healthcare. Abdulmalik Gajam, the state's Commissioner for Budget and Planning, points to the past leadership under Bello Matawalle as having shown insufficient dedication to progress in these sectors. Statistical evaluations place Zamfara near the bottom among Nigerian states in terms of GDP, imports, industrialization, healthcare quality, educational standards, and ICT, as documented by a 2022 independent review. Gajam describes Zamfara's situation as dire, with these evaluations supported by data. Zamfara is also burdened with over N30 billion in debt servicing obligations for the current year, with more than N20 billion already paid. Gajam questions how these loans benefited the state, alleging past funds were not directed to productive uses. For example, the state transport company is unreliable, and a proposed airport project—promised for over a decade—remains nonexistent, despite N13 billion allocated under the previous administration. Documented evidence indicates no tangible progress. Infrastructure and basic services remain underdeveloped. According to Gajam, healthcare funds led to incomplete or empty medical centers, some initially funded by the World Bank but now lacking equipment and staff. The state is still dealing with health emergencies, such as recurring cholera outbreaks. Education has similarly been neglected. The previous administration failed to pay examination fees for secondary students for three years, leaving Zamfara’s youth trailing behind their peers in other regions. No substantial progress was made in education or infrastructure, and resources were allegedly spent on luxuries and incomplete building projects. The past government is further accused of providing vehicles and extending sanctuary to armed groups, escalating the security crisis. Upon assuming office, the Lawal administration found neglected security resources and unpaid police and military allowances, prompting the creation of a security trust fund as part of efforts to restore security. For the past two decades, Zamfara reportedly lacked effective policy planning and capacity-building for civil servants. The current government is restructuring by consolidating ministries and agencies and adopting a streamlined governance model. Security is the top priority, but the challenges require continued assistance from the federal government. While frustration persists over the legacy of previous leadership, Gajam emphasizes that accountability is essential for Zamfara’s recovery and future growth.

Abdulmalik Gajam, commissaire d'État au budget et à la planification, désigne l'administration précédente de Bello Matawalle comme insuffisamment engagée en matière de progrès dans ces secteurs. Des rapports statistiques placent le Zamfara parmi les plus bas du classement national pour le PIB, les importations, l'industrialisation, la qualité des soins de santé, l'éducation et les TIC, selon une étude indépendante publiée en 2022. Gajam juge la situation du Zamfara critique, ce que confirment les chiffres. Le Zamfara doit également s'acquitter de plus de 30 milliards de nairas en service de la dette sur l'année, dont plus de 20 milliards déjà remboursés. Gajam questionne l'impact de ces emprunts, soulignant que les fonds n'ont pas servi à des projets concrets. Par exemple, la société de transport public est peu performante, et le projet d'aéroport, promis depuis plus de dix ans, n'a connu aucune avancée malgré l'allocation de 13 milliards de nairas par l'ancienne administration. Les preuves documentées le confirment. Les infrastructures et services de base demeurent sous-développés. Selon Gajam, les crédits octroyés à la santé ont abouti à des centres médicaux vides ou inachevés — certains initialement financés par la Banque mondiale, mais sans équipements ni personnel. L'État connaît toujours des urgences sanitaires, notamment des épidémies de choléra. L'éducation est aussi délaissée. L'ancienne administration n'a pas réglé les frais d'examen de trois années consécutives pour les élèves du secondaire, retardant la jeunesse face aux autres régions. Aucun progrès significatif n’a été observé dans l’éducation ou les infrastructures ; selon les accusations, des fonds publics auraient été dilapidés dans des projets de prestige ou inachevés. L'ancien gouvernement est également pointé du doigt pour avoir fourni des véhicules et accordé un refuge à des groupes armés, ce qui aurait aggravé la crise sécuritaire. À son arrivée, la nouvelle administration a trouvé des ressources sécuritaires négligées et des forces de l'ordre impayées, d'où la création d’un fonds spécial de sécurité par l’équipe Lawal. Depuis vingt ans, le Zamfara aurait manqué d’une planification politique efficace et d’initiatives de formation pour ses agents publics. L’administration actuelle restructure en fusionnant ministères et agences, et adopte un modèle plus épuré. La sécurité reste la priorité numéro un, mais les défis nécessitent toujours le soutien du gouvernement fédéral. Malgré la frustration causée par le passé, Gajam insiste sur le fait que la transparence et la redevabilité sont indispensables pour le redressement et l’avenir du Zamfara.

Robert Powell, 49, a former NASCAR driver, was arrested this week on multiple drug-related charges, including possession and manufacturing of methamphetamine, following an investigation by local authorities in Goose Creek, South Carolina. The inquiry began after neighbors reported suspicious activity at Powell's residence. According to MS News Now, police found methamphetamine paraphernalia—including empty containers of drain cleaner, batteries, cold medicine, and several syringes (one testing positive for meth)—in a garbage can outside Powell’s home. Powell and his housemate, Elma Buchanan, were subsequently arrested after police searched the residence. Both suspects were released on bond from the Berkeley County Detention Center on Tuesday morning, according to Examiner.

Powell had a distinguished career in NASCAR’s Weekly Series from 1984 to 2002, securing 111 victories in 328 starts at tracks such as Summerville, Florence Motor, and Myrtle Beach Speedways. In 1988, he became the youngest driver to win a NASCAR series title at age 23. He belongs to a family with a strong racing background—his brother Charles was a national championship contender in 1984, and his father, Charley, was a notable figure in southern dirt Late Model racing, according to Nascar.com. Powell also competed in other notable series, including the NASCAR All-American Challenge and the AutoZone Elite and Southeast series.

However, this is not Powell's first encounter with law enforcement. Records show an extensive criminal history dating back to 1992, with prior arrests for forgery, burglary, assaulting a police officer, and aggravated criminal domestic violence.

article_content: A resolution recently passed by the Burlington City Council could lead to a citywide ban on assault rifles and high-capacity magazines in Vermont's most populous city. The council voted 10 to 3 in favor of the measure. Councilor Norm Blais, a Democrat, sponsored the resolution, stating he was motivated by President Barack Obama’s call for a national conversation on weapons following the deadly Sandy Hook Elementary School shootings in Newtown, Connecticut, last December. The resolution will now be subject to public hearings, a public vote, and must be approved by the state legislature before it can become law in Burlington. During the city council meeting, opinions were divided. Many residents spoke against the resolution, calling it too broad and unnecessary, according to CNN affiliate WPTZ. Burlington Police Chief Michael Schirling noted that most gun crimes in the city involve handguns rather than assault weapons. Vermont is known for having some of the least restrictive gun laws in the United States, permitting individuals to carry firearms openly or concealed almost anywhere except on school grounds and in courthouses, as reported by CNN affiliate WCAX. Meeting attendee Matt Storer urged the council not to pass legislation based on emotions in the wake of recent events. He cautioned against letting emotions drive the creation of amendments that might infringe on constitutional rights. Councilor Blais said he intentionally drafted the proposal broadly so it could incorporate feedback from officials and community members who support gun rights, aiming for a fair amendment. He clarified that his intention was not to prevent sportsmen from hunting or people from defending themselves, but to help ensure the safety of Burlington residents in the aftermath of tragedies like Newtown.

article_content: The Labour Party is facing increased scrutiny over its association with Paul Flowers, the former chair of the Co-op Bank who has been embroiled in personal scandal. New images have surfaced showing Labour leaders Ed Miliband and Ed Balls hosting an upscale reception at Downing Street attended by Flowers and other senior figures from the Co-op during their time in government. It has been reported that Labour was told two years prior that Flowers was forced to resign as a city councillor after adult (but not illegal) material was found on his council computer. This detail was not communicated to the Co-op, allowing Flowers to serve as chairman until June. In this role, he authorized large financial donations to Labour and to Ed Balls. Conservative politicians are pressing Miliband and Balls to fully explain their relationship with Flowers, who was suspended from the Labour Party after being filmed buying illegal drugs. Both have tried to distance themselves from him since the revelations. The February 2010 Downing Street event, where Flowers was seen mingling with Labour ministers, remains in the spotlight. Also present was Len Wardle, who resigned as chairman of the Co-op over the decision to appoint Flowers. Ed Balls, among Labour MPs supported financially by the Co-op, attended the event designed to promote the ‘Friends of the Co-operative ideal’. Reports highlight that Miliband was highly sought after at the event because of his role shaping Labour's election manifesto. Following the event, Flowers, who considered Balls a political friend, was appointed to the Co-op’s political strategy working group and, together with Wardle, approved millions in donations to Labour and the Co-operative parties, including £50,000 to Balls. During this period, the Co-op increased its political donations significantly. After the Downing Street gathering, Miliband named Flowers to an exclusive business advisory board. The two held further meetings in Westminster in July and November 2011, and in March 2013, Miliband invited Flowers for private talks at his parliamentary office. The following month, Labour secured a £1.2 million loan from the Co-op Bank. Grant Shapps, Conservative Party chairman, demanded answers from Labour about its knowledge of Flowers’ resignation from Bradford council and their dealings during his tenure at the Co-op. Brooks Newmark, a Conservative MP on the Treasury committee, questioned whether Labour was involved in Flowers’ career progression and raised concerns about accepting donations from the Co-op while he was chairman. Flowers’ abrupt resignation from the council followed the discovery of inappropriate images during a computer servicing. The public was not informed of this, with Flowers stating he was leaving for personal reasons and demanding work. Council leaders lauded his service, and the Co-op was never told the real reason for his departure. Labour denies close ties with Flowers. After the latest revelations, Miliband’s team suspended Flowers from the party, expressing shock at his actions. Meanwhile, Ed Balls faces renewed calls to return the Co-op’s £50,000 donation, which his spokesperson maintains was validly given.

The recently released biopic of Apple co-founder Steve Jobs, titled 'Jobs,' has sparked a public exchange between Apple's other co-founder, Steve Wozniak, and Ashton Kutcher, who portrays Jobs in the film. Wozniak posted a review on Gizmodo, describing the film as 'fiction' and criticizing Kutcher for being 'disingenuous.' The movie traces Jobs's path from college dropout to the launch of the iPod in 2001, but has received mixed reviews in the U.S. since debuting.

Wozniak wrote, 'I suspect a lot of what was wrong with the film came from Ashton's own image of Jobs.' Kutcher prepared for the role by immersing himself in Jobs's life, even adopting his diet. Kutcher, who has expressed deep admiration for Jobs, accused Wozniak of bias due to involvement in a competing Jobs film project and said Wozniak was unavailable for consultation during production.

Wozniak clarified that the script was complete before he was approached, making his input moot, and said he was discouraged by the script itself. He has reportedly met with Aaron Sorkin, who is adapting Walter Isaacson's official Jobs biography into another film. Wozniak also noted that the film overlooks contributions from early Apple collaborators, such as Ronald Wayne, and recounted how he gave a significant amount of Apple stock to early employees—a detail not shown in the film.

He questioned the film's accuracy, a sentiment shared by other reviewers, and expressed disappointment over how people he knew were portrayed. Wozniak argued that Jobs was depicted as a visionary too early in the film, whereas he believes that reputation was earned later. Despite the inaccuracies, Wozniak praised the acting but said he could not recommend the movie as an accurate account of events. Wozniak, the designer of the Apple II, left the company in 1987.

Rumors in the Swiss press have swirled around a possible relationship between FIFA president Sepp Blatter and Linda Barras, after the two appeared together at the recent FIFA Ballon d'Or gala in Zurich. The speculation began when Linda, aged 49 and mother of two, was photographed with Blatter at the event. Her husband, Christian Barras, a Swiss estate agent, said he was unaware of any romantic involvement and affirmed that he is still married to Linda.

Family members have also spoken out, with Christian highlighting Linda’s friendship with Blatter’s niece, while another relative said it was likely a misunderstanding and maintained that Linda and Christian are together. During the gala, Linda was seen chatting with Blatter, with football legend Pele also present.

Linda has known Blatter for years, partly through her former role as president of the charity event La Nuit Des Neiges, which supports both local and international causes and has seen Blatter attend in the past. The Swiss tabloid Blick fueled the rumors by naming Linda as Blatter’s 'new love,' but these assertions have been denied by those close to her.

Blatter, serving as FIFA president since 1998, has been married three times and has a daughter. His ex-wife, Graziella Blatter-Bianca, commented positively about the rumors, saying she is pleased he may have found happiness, even though she does not personally know Linda. Graziella also described the challenges of being married to someone leading such a high-profile life.

FIFA has refused to comment directly on the rumors, with a spokesperson confirming that Blatter’s guest at the Ballon d'Or event was there in a personal capacity. Cristiano Ronaldo won the Ballon d'Or this year.

article_content: Though the image might resemble a gigantic eye in the sky or a scene from a science fiction movie, it actually reveals the violent reality of planet formation. Captured by the Hubble Space Telescope, these remarkable images show the enormous dusty debris disks surrounding various stars. These debris disks are created by collisions between leftover objects from planet formation, and they have been observed around stars as young as 10 million years old and as old as over 1 billion years. A particularly striking image shows the disk around the star HD 181327, featuring a huge spray of debris that may have been caused by a recent collision between two bodies in the outer part of the system. Irregularities in the disk of HD 181327 resemble a massive spray of debris, possibly resulting from such a collision. In some systems, collisions between large bodies can throw out debris, which then coalesces into companion moons. The observed collision around HD 181327 might mirror how the Earth-moon system formed. Survey leader Glenn Schneider of the University of Arizona's Steward Observatory noted, “It’s like looking back in time to see the kinds of destructive events that once routinely happened in our solar system after the planets formed.” The survey’s results were published in the October 1, 2014 issue of The Astronomical Journal. Once thought to be simple pancake-like structures, these disks display unexpected diversity and complexity. The distribution of dust suggests the disks may be influenced by unseen exoplanets, or possibly by the star moving through interstellar space. Researchers found that no two debris disks look the same. Schneider explained, “We find that the systems are not simply flat with uniform surfaces. These are actually pretty complicated three-dimensional debris systems, often with embedded smaller structures. Some of these could signal the presence of hidden planets." Astronomers used Hubble’s Space Telescope Imaging Spectrograph to study 10 previously discovered circumstellar debris systems. The distant spray of material in HD 181327 is roughly twice as far from its star as Pluto is from our sun. Co-investigator Christopher Stark commented, “Catastrophically destroying an object that massive at such a large distance is difficult to explain, and it should be very rare. If we are seeing the aftermath of a massive collision, the unseen planetary system may be quite chaotic.” Since 1995, astronomers have found nearly 4,000 exoplanet candidates, mostly through indirect methods, but have only imaged about two dozen circumstellar debris systems. The architecture of these systems varies greatly, and planets are found in orbits that differ significantly from those in our solar system. Schneider added, “We are now seeing a similar diversity in the architecture of the accompanying debris systems. There is some interdependence between the planets and their debris disks that might influence how these systems evolve.” Because disks are typically 100,000 times fainter than their bright parent stars and often very close to them, they are difficult to see. Most images have come from Hubble’s high-contrast imaging, which blocks the star's light to reveal the faint surrounding disk. These observations offer insights into how our solar system formed and evolved 4.6 billion years ago.
translated_content: Même si l'image ressemble à un gigantesque œil dans le ciel ou à une scène de film de science-fiction, elle révèle en réalité la violence de la formation des planètes. Capturée par le télescope spatial Hubble, ces images remarquables montrent d'immenses disques de poussière entourant diverses étoiles. Ces disques de débris se forment à la suite de collisions entre des objets résiduels issus de la formation planétaire, et ils ont été observés autour d'étoiles aussi jeunes que 10 millions d'années et aussi vieilles que plus d'un milliard d'années. Une image particulièrement frappante montre le disque autour de l’étoile HD 181327, présentant une grande gerbe de débris qui pourrait avoir été causée par une collision récente entre deux corps dans la partie externe du système. Des irrégularités dans le disque de HD 181327 ressemblent à une énorme projection de débris, probablement issue d'une telle collision. Dans certains systèmes, des collisions entre de grands corps peuvent projeter des débris, qui se regroupent ensuite pour former des lunes compagnons. La collision observée autour de HD 181327 pourrait ressembler à la formation du système Terre-Lune. Le responsable de l’étude, Glenn Schneider de l’Observatoire Steward de l’Université d’Arizona, a déclaré : « C’est comme regarder dans le passé et voir les événements destructeurs qui se produisaient régulièrement dans notre système solaire après la formation des planètes. » Les résultats de l’étude ont été publiés dans l’édition du 1er octobre 2014 du magazine The Astronomical Journal. Autrefois considérés comme des structures plates et simples, ces disques révèlent une diversité et une complexité inattendues. La répartition de la poussière suggère qu’ils pourraient être influencés par des exoplanètes invisibles, ou peut-être par le mouvement de l’étoile à travers l’espace interstellaire. Les chercheurs ont constaté qu’aucun disque de débris n’est identique. Schneider a expliqué : « Nous constatons que les systèmes ne sont pas simplement plats avec des surfaces uniformes. Ce sont en fait des systèmes de débris tridimensionnels complexes, comportant souvent de plus petites structures incluses. Certaines pourraient indiquer la présence de planètes cachées. » Les astronomes ont utilisé le spectrographe imageur du télescope spatial Hubble pour étudier dix systèmes de débris circumstellaires découverts précédemment. La gerbe éloignée de matériaux dans HD 181327 se trouve à environ deux fois la distance entre Pluton et le Soleil. Le co-chercheur Christopher Stark a commenté : « Détruire de façon catastrophique un objet aussi massif à une telle distance est difficile à expliquer, et cela devrait être très rare. Si nous observons effectivement les conséquences d'une collision majeure, le système planétaire invisible pourrait être assez chaotique. » Depuis 1995, les astronomes ont identifié près de 4 000 candidats exoplanètes, principalement par méthodes indirectes, mais ils n'ont imagé qu’une vingtaine de systèmes de débris circumstellaires. L’architecture de ces systèmes est très variée, avec des planètes aux orbites très différentes de celles de notre système solaire. Schneider ajoute : « Nous constatons désormais une diversité similaire dans l’architecture des systèmes de débris associés. Il existe une certaine interdépendance entre les planètes et leur disque de débris, susceptible d’influencer l’évolution de ces systèmes exoplanétaires. » Comme ces disques sont généralement 100 000 fois plus faibles que leurs étoiles parentales très brillantes et souvent très proches d’elles, il est difficile de les observer. La plupart des images ont été obtenues grâce à l’imagerie à contraste élevé de Hubble, qui masque la lumière de l’étoile pour révéler le disque faible qui l’entoure. Ces observations nous offrent un aperçu de la formation et de l’évolution de notre propre système solaire il y a 4,6 milliards d’années.

article_content: Kevin Kuske is recognized as one of the fastest men on ice, boasting four Olympic gold medals and seven world championship titles in bobsleigh. Partnered with Thomas Florschutz, Kuske can reach speeds of up to 155 kilometers per hour as they navigate the high-speed twists of the bobsleigh track. Kuske, 33, explained in an interview with CNN's 'Human to Hero' series that the sport is not only fast and thrilling but also inherently dangerous, with accidents sometimes resulting in serious injuries. Called the 'brakeman,' Kuske's main role is to deliver a powerful push-start before jumping into the sled, while Florschutz, 34, steers. Kuske's sprinting ability has been measured at 3.69 seconds for the first 30 meters—quicker than legendary sprinter Usain Bolt achieved in the same distance during his 2008 Olympic 100m gold run. Kuske started his athletic career as a track and field runner, winning a bronze in the 4x100m relay at the 1998 world junior championships. His larger build prompted a switch to bobsleigh, encouraged by coach Gerd Leopold. Kuske won his first Olympic gold in Salt Lake City in 2002 with Germany’s four-man team, followed by double golds in Turin 2006, another gold in Vancouver 2010, and silver in the four-man event. Florschutz, who earned silver in the two-man event in Vancouver, has teamed up with Kuske to pursue further success, aiming for world championship victory in St. Moritz and gold at the 2014 Sochi Olympics. Despite their experience, both athletes maintain an intense year-round training regime, including twice-daily workouts focused on strength and speed. Kuske has a background in the German Federal Defense Force, and Florschutz is a policeman. Together, they strive to extend Germany's tradition of success in bobsleigh. Kuske particularly cherishes a silver medal from Vancouver after a dramatic comeback in the final run. Inspired by his parents, both former national athletes, Kuske views the Olympics as a lifelong dream that became reality. Florschutz hopes that their partnership, formed after the retirement of celebrated driver Andre Lange, will lead to further world and Olympic titles.

article_content: A lorry driver has been banned from drinking in pubs for a year after he drunkenly climbed an eight-foot gate to enter the grounds of Windsor Castle, a court heard. Robert Pennefather, 32, from Ireland, came within 20 yards of the Queen's private apartments in the early hours of November 6 after a night out drinking with colleagues. He admitted to trespassing at the historic palace, triggering a series of alarms that prompted officers from two separate police forces to respond, Westminster Magistrates' Court was told. Pennefather explained that he 'got lost' on his way home. Police on duty at Windsor Castle spotted him on CCTV at 3:34 am, visibly staggering along Cambridge Drive, approximately 150 yards from Cambridge Gate. Prosecutor Zoe Martin described how Pennefather was seen heading toward an area known as South Lawn. When stopped by armed police and asked to produce a security pass, he replied, 'what pass?' and soon acknowledged, 'Yes, I should not be here.' He told police his friends had left him, adding, 'They've gone.' Pennefather said he could not remember how he entered the castle grounds and insisted he thought it was possible to just walk in, claiming not to have seen any signage and stating he was trying to find an exit when approached by officers. At the time of his arrest, Pennefather was approximately 20 metres from the Queen's private apartments, but the Queen was not in residence. Defending, Ian Brownhill described the incident as 'a case of drunken folly,' saying Pennefather had been drinking heavily and simply tried to take a shortcut back to his cab to sleep. 'There was nothing sinister in this whatsoever, nor any suggestion he meant harm to the royal family,' Brownhill added. Pennefather, who is married and earns £600 per week, wanted to apologize to both the Queen and the Duke of Edinburgh. Chief Magistrate Howard Riddle imposed a 14-day prison sentence suspended for 12 months, recognizing that Pennefather posed no danger and had no intention of entering the castle itself. The court emphasized the seriousness of the security breach, noting the alarm it caused and the necessity of deploying police officers who could have been needed elsewhere. In addition to the suspended sentence and year-long pub ban, Pennefather was fined £1,000, ordered to pay £85 in prosecution costs, and given a £15 victim surcharge.

Robert Pennefather, 32 ans, originaire d’Irlande, s'est approché à moins de 20 mètres des appartements privés de la reine au petit matin du 6 novembre, après une soirée arrosée avec des collègues. Lors de son interpellation, Pennefather se trouvait à environ 20 mètres des appartements privés de la reine, qui n'était pas présente à ce moment-là. Selon son avocat, Ian Brownhill, il s'agit « d’une simple erreur liée à l’ivresse », soulignant que Pennefather avait beaucoup bu et tentait simplement de retrouver son camion pour y dormir. « Il n’y avait rien de malveillant dans ses actes, ni aucun signe de volonté de nuire à la famille royale », a assuré son avocat. Le tribunal a toutefois souligné la gravité de la faille de sécurité, l’inquiétude suscitée, et la mobilisation des forces de police. En plus du sursis et de l'interdiction de fréquenter les pubs pendant un an, Pennefather a écopé d'une amende de 1 000 £, ainsi que de 85 £ de frais de justice et une contribution de 15 £ pour les victimes.

article_content: Christopher Nolan, the celebrated director behind films like 'Interstellar', 'Inception', and the 'Dark Knight' trilogy, deliberately avoids using much of today’s common technology. He chooses not to use email, believing it doesn’t add value to his work, and says, 'I just couldn't be bothered.' Nolan also does not own a smartphone, explaining that not having one gives him crucial time to think undisturbed. He notes that since he’s usually surrounded by colleagues, someone can always pass him a phone if he needs to communicate. When he started making films in Los Angeles in 1997, mobile phones were rare, and he’s maintained that practice ever since. Although his films often feature high-tech gadgets, Nolan has called mobile phones 'just toys for grown-ups.' Warner Bros once set up an email account for him without his knowledge, leading to a backlog of thousands of messages until he had the account shut down. 'Interstellar', featuring Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway, and Michael Caine, has made £426 million worldwide and has even influenced scientific research. Nolan co-wrote the screenplay with his brother Jonathan, over a decade after the two first earned acclaim for their dark reimagining of the Batman franchise.

Étant souvent entouré de collaborateurs, quelqu’un peut toujours lui prêter un téléphone en cas de besoin. Même si ses films mettent en scène des gadgets high-tech, Nolan a déjà qualifié les téléphones portables de « jouets pour adultes ». Warner Bros lui avait attribué une adresse e-mail à son insu, ce qui a mené à une accumulation de milliers de messages jusqu'à ce qu'il fasse fermer le compte. « Interstellar », avec Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway et Michael Caine, a rapporté 426 millions de livres sterling dans le monde et a même alimenté la recherche scientifique. Nolan a écrit le scénario avec son frère Jonathan, plus de dix ans après leur succès commun lors de la refonte sombre du Batman.

article_content: England striker Wayne Rooney has avoided any additional punishment after displaying frustration following his sending off during Manchester United's weekend defeat at Fulham. Rooney confronted referee Phil Dowd after receiving a red card in the match. The Football Association will issue Rooney a formal written warning after he punched the corner flag while leaving the pitch. Rooney was sent off for two bookable offences during United's 2-0 loss—the second yellow card came when he threw the ball in the direction where referee Phil Dowd wanted a free kick to be taken. Although Rooney exchanged words with Dowd after being shown the red card, the referee confirmed that Rooney did not use abusive language. An FA spokesperson stated: 'We have clarified with Phil Dowd that there was no abuse from the player after he was dismissed. Regarding the incident with the corner flag, the referee did not see it, and we have written to Wayne Rooney reminding him of his responsibilities.' As a result, Rooney's suspension will be limited to one match: the Premier League game against Aston Villa at Old Trafford on April 5.

La Fédération anglaise de football adressera à Rooney un avertissement écrit après qu'il a frappé le poteau de corner en quittant le terrain. Rooney a été exclu après deux cartons jaunes lors de la défaite 2-0 de United—le deuxième avertissement est intervenu lorsqu'il a lancé le ballon vers l'endroit où l'arbitre Phil Dowd souhaitait que le coup franc soit joué. Bien que Rooney ait eu un échange verbal avec Dowd après avoir reçu le carton rouge, l'arbitre a confirmé qu'il n'avait pas employé de langage injurieux. Un porte-parole de la Fédération a déclaré : « Nous avons confirmé avec Phil Dowd qu'il n'y a eu aucun abus de la part du joueur après son expulsion. Concernant l'incident avec le poteau de corner, l'arbitre ne l'a pas vu et nous avons écrit à Wayne Rooney pour lui rappeler ses responsabilités. » En conséquence, la suspension de Rooney sera limitée à un match : celui de Premier League contre Aston Villa à Old Trafford le 5 avril.

article_content:
Rhea Loucas, founder of Zurich-based PlanetPlay, has been an avid gamer since childhood. During the Covid pandemic, she returned to gaming and, in 2021, left her accounting role at EY to create PlanetPlay—a gaming marketplace dedicated to environmental impact.

“Europe has become unbearably hot in the last five years. I considered how everyday people could help tackle climate change. Many solutions lack reach, but video games can engage large audiences,” Loucas explains.

PlanetPlay operates as both a creative agency and an eco-donation platform, functioning much like an e-commerce business. By collaborating with game developers, PlanetPlay integrates climate-focused messages into in-game activations, raising funds through both in-game purchases and its marketplace. All proceeds support certified climate initiatives, with their environmental impact tracked by the issuance of carbon credits.

How does it work? Users purchase in-game bundles known as 'green assets.' A portion of the revenue from these assets is directed toward climate projects. Players also receive 'green coins' symbolizing their donation. These coins can be used in PlanetPlay’s marketplace to retire carbon credits directly or to acquire in-game items. If green coins are spent on purchases, game companies or vendors can then retire those associated carbon credits.

When asked about funding, Loucas notes, “PlanetPlay is financed by our family office, which set aside a budget for a climate initiative. Instead of a one-off donation, we wanted to establish a sustainable impact model.” PlanetPlay maintains robust governance, with a majority non-executive supervisory board ensuring its not-for-profit status. The company’s purpose is strictly philanthropic.

PlanetPlay’s revenue primarily comes from fundraising through in-game assets and, notably, sales on its marketplace. Over 400 games are listed, a number growing daily. Game publishers select the donation proportion—minimum 10%—which is displayed to players and on the website. All proceeds go to climate projects, some of which generate economic returns, such as solar farms.

As the first not-for-profit gaming marketplace combating climate change, PlanetPlay uniquely empowers players to contribute to climate action. Their target is to reduce one billion tons of carbon emissions annually.

Since launching at the end of 2022, PlanetPlay has run in-game campaigns not only within gaming but also through the music industry. Recent collaborations include Sybo x J Balvin and Avakin Life x Fat Joe, both raising funds and awareness. These campaigns have bolstered key performance indicators for partners, including player engagement, more daily play, and increased in-game purchases. PlanetPlay charges lower platform fees compared to the 30% typical of commercial platforms and has reached over 120,000 players in less than six months.

Reflecting on her journey, Loucas shares lessons learned: The initial vision blended art and gaming, but the business plan proved unsustainable, leading to an early partner’s departure. Refocusing, Loucas’ team developed a digital platform and API, interviewing over twenty game studios before securing a partner. Shortly thereafter, a major deal was canceled unexpectedly, forcing another pivot. Loucas emphasizes that resilience and persistence were key to PlanetPlay’s eventual success.

« L’Europe est devenue insupportablement chaude ces cinq dernières années. Je me suis demandé comment les gens ordinaires peuvent contribuer à lutter contre le changement climatique. Beaucoup de solutions n’atteignent pas assez de monde, mais les jeux vidéo peuvent mobiliser un large public », explique Loucas.

PlanetPlay fonctionne à la fois comme une agence créative et une plateforme de dons écologiques, sur le modèle d’un site e-commerce. En partenariat avec des développeurs de jeux, PlanetPlay intègre des messages pro-climat dans les jeux et collecte des fonds via les achats in-game et sa place de marché. Tous les fonds sont reversés à des projets climatiques certifiés, mesurés par l’émission de crédits carbone.

Comment ça marche ? Les utilisateurs achètent des packs dans le jeu, appelés « actifs verts ». Une partie des revenus est consacrée à ces projets. Les joueurs reçoivent également des « green coins » en gage de leur don. Ces pièces servent sur la place de marché de PlanetPlay pour annuler des crédits carbone ou acheter des objets pour leurs jeux. Interrogée sur le financement, Loucas précise : « PlanetPlay est financée par notre family office, qui a dédié un budget à une initiative pour le climat. Nous avons voulu créer un modèle durable plutôt que de faire un simple don ponctuel. » La société dispose d’une gouvernance solide, avec une majorité d’administrateurs non exécutifs assurant son statut d’organisation à but non lucratif. La vocation de PlanetPlay est uniquement philanthropique.

Les revenus de PlanetPlay proviennent essentiellement de la collecte via les actifs verts et surtout de la vente sur sa place de marché. Plus de 400 jeux y sont proposés, un chiffre en augmentation constante. Les éditeurs choisissent le pourcentage de don – au minimum 10 % – qui est affiché aux joueurs et sur le site. Tous les fonds sont versés à des projets climatiques, certains générant également des retours économiques comme des fermes solaires.

Première place de marché de jeux vidéo à but non lucratif dédiée à la lutte contre le changement climatique, PlanetPlay permet aux joueurs de s’engager facilement pour le climat. L’objectif affiché : réduire un milliard de tonnes de CO2 chaque année.

Depuis son lancement fin 2022, PlanetPlay a mené des campagnes in-game dans le secteur du jeu vidéo mais aussi dans la musique. Parmi les collaborations récentes : Sybo x J Balvin, et Avakin Life x Fat Joe, des opérations qui permettent de lever des fonds et de sensibiliser. Ces campagnes ont fait grimper les principaux indicateurs des partenaires, comme l’engagement, le temps de jeu quotidien et les achats dans les jeux. PlanetPlay pratique des frais de plateforme bien inférieurs aux 30 % habituels du secteur et a séduit plus de 120 000 joueurs en moins de six mois.

Rhea Loucas revient sur les leçons apprises : L’idée initiale associant art et jeux n’était pas soutenable, ce qui a poussé sa première associée à quitter l’aventure. Loucas et son équipe se sont recentrées sur une plateforme digitale et une API, rencontrant plus de vingt studios avant de convaincre un partenaire. Peu après, un accord important a été annulé à la dernière minute, imposant un nouveau pivot. Selon Loucas, la résilience et la persévérance ont été essentielles à la réussite de PlanetPlay.

article_content: Thomas Cato, 23, from Dolgellau, North Wales, is reported to be responsible for about half of the crimes recorded in his hometown of 3,000 people, according to a local court. He was recently caught stealing a meat pie and a pair of rubber gloves valued at £2.29 from his local Co-Op store while already serving a suspended sentence for burglary. Instead of a jail term, magistrates sentenced him to 40 hours of unpaid work, dividing the hours between the breach of his suspended sentence and the new shoplifting charge. Cato's solicitor, Nicola Jones, stated that imprisonment would be disproportionate, since Cato had recently been diagnosed with mental health challenges and helping him address these issues would benefit the community. Additionally, he was not ordered to pay further court costs because he still owes £3,000 in unpaid fines and compensation from earlier convictions. Conservative MP Philip Davies criticized the decision, arguing that failing to enforce suspended sentences for repeat offenses weakens public confidence in the justice system.

Il a récemment été appréhendé pour avoir volé une tourte à la viande et une paire de gants en caoutchouc estimées à 2,29 £ dans son magasin Co-Op, alors qu’il purgeait déjà une peine avec sursis pour cambriolage. Health officials have reported seven additional measles cases in an outbreak linked to recent visits to Disney theme parks in California. The California Department of Public Health (CDPH) confirmed Monday that the outbreak has grown to 26 cases across four states: 22 in California, two in Utah, and one each in Colorado and Washington. Most patients visited Disneyland or Disney California Adventure between December 15 and December 20, 2014, though some may have been infected by others who had visited the parks.

Three of the new cases were reported in Southern California—two in San Bernardino County and one in Long Beach. Long Beach City Health Officer Mitchell Kushner said that possible exposure sites on January 3 included the Total Wellness Club, Stater Brothers supermarket, Bank of America, and a Wells Fargo branch in Long Beach between 9 a.m. and 11:30 a.m. Dr. Kushner also said that the Long Beach resident with measles had visited the Disneyland Resort in Anaheim from December 16 to December 20, 2014.

Additional locations identified as potential exposure sites by officials, as reported by The Los Angeles Times, are Morongo Casino in Cabazon (January 4, 6–11:30 p.m.), Magic Wok in Chino (January 6, 3–5 p.m.), Jimmy Warehouse Sportscard in Whittier (January 6, 3–10 p.m.), and Urgent Care at Pomona Valley Health Center in Chino (January 8, 3:56–5:05 p.m.).

Last week, the CDPH confirmed related measles cases in Alameda, Orange, Pasadena, Riverside, San Diego, and Ventura counties. The CDPH noted that measles typically starts with fever, cough, runny nose, and red eyes, followed a few days later by a red rash that usually starts on the face and spreads downward. Measles is a highly contagious airborne disease that has been considered eliminated in the United States since 2000. However, large outbreaks have been reported in Western Europe, Pakistan, Vietnam, and the Philippines in recent years. Travelers returning from these regions can bring measles into the U.S., resulting in limited domestic spread.

Disney theme parks are international destinations, welcoming visitors from around the world, including areas where measles remains common. Disney officials have stated they are cooperating with public health authorities to assist in the response.

La semaine dernière, le CDPH a confirmé d’autres cas liés dans les comtés d’Alameda, Orange, Pasadena, Riverside, San Diego et Ventura. Le CDPH rappelle que la rougeole débute généralement par de la fièvre, une toux, un nez qui coule et les yeux rouges, puis, quelques jours plus tard, une éruption rouge qui démarre sur le visage et descend sur le corps. C’est une maladie aérienne très contagieuse, considérée comme éradiquée aux États-Unis depuis 2000. Cependant, d’importantes épidémies ont été observées ces dernières années en Europe occidentale, au Pakistan, au Vietnam et aux Philippines. Les voyageurs revenant de ces régions peuvent ramener la rougeole aux États-Unis, provoquant alors une transmission domestique limitée.

Les parcs Disney sont des destinations internationales recevant des visiteurs du monde entier, y compris de pays où la rougeole demeure fréquente. Les responsables de Disney ont indiqué qu’ils collaborent avec les autorités sanitaires pour assister dans la gestion de l’épidémie.

article_content: A new video has surfaced showing the first flight of the US Air Force's newest strategic bomber, the B-21 Raider, which is also the first new stealth bomber developed in decades. On Friday, freelance photojournalist Matt Hartman shared footage on X (formerly Twitter) of what he identified as the B-21 Raider flying after takeoff from the Northrop Grumman Corporation facility at Plant 42 in Palmdale, California. Reuters photographed the plane on the runway before its flight. The first flight was confirmed by US Air Force spokesperson Ann Stefanek, who stated that the B-21 Raider is currently undergoing flight testing. Stefanek explained that this stage is a critical step in the test campaign managed by the Air Force Test Center and the 412th Test Wing's B-21 Combined Test Force. This event represents a major step for what has been described as the world's first sixth-generation aircraft, which was unveiled in December 2022. At the unveiling, Northrop Grumman announced that the first flight was scheduled for 2023, with six test planes in development. Doug Young, sector vice president and general manager of Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems, described the B-21 as the most advanced military aircraft ever built and a product of pioneering innovation. This new aircraft is the first US stealth bomber introduced in over 30 years. According to its manufacturer, it incorporates next-generation stealth technology and long-range capabilities, making it adaptable for a wide range of missions. Pentagon leaders have said that the stealth bomber will serve as the backbone of America's bomber fleet. The B-21 Raider, a 'flying wing' design, succeeds the B-2 Spirit and can carry both conventional and nuclear weapons. It is designed to be modified to accommodate future weapons, including those not yet invented, according to the Secretary of Defense.

article_content: Bryan Crutchfield is Vice President and General Manager for North America at Materialise, a global leader in 3D printing.  Personalization is an emerging trend across many industries, from customizable apps on our devices to car manufacturers offering various trim levels and software features. In health care, personalization can even be life-saving. Because every patient is unique, one-size-fits-all solutions may be ineffective and can result in lower success rates or costly, repeated visits.  Thanks to advanced planning and manufacturing technologies, clinicians can now provide patient-specific care, potentially improving outcomes and saving lives. This signals a shift toward mass personalization and tailored treatments.  Forms of Personalization in Health Care Personalization in health care takes many forms, from allowing patients to choose between in-person and virtual appointments to using genetic information for treatment decisions. For example, genetic testing can help doctors identify patients predisposed to certain conditions. Meanwhile, technologies like 3D printing enable the planning of medical procedures and the creation of patient-specific implants to replace damaged or missing bone.  Numerous companies in the mass personalization space are working to improve patient outcomes with solutions as unique as each individual.  Trends and Predictions for Mass Personalization Last year, my company hosted an event bringing together clinicians, researchers, and experts from medical device firms to discuss opportunities and challenges in medical mass personalization. Most attendees (89%) believed that this technology will become the new standard of care or sustain widespread use within the next decade.  Additionally, more than 95% saw 3D printing at the point of care as a significant opportunity, particularly in procedural planning. Integrating 3D printing into healthcare facilities is increasingly part of product strategies for many medical device companies.  Slightly over 70% of event participants believe that, in ten years, data, artificial intelligence (AI), and statistical shape modeling will surpass humans in predictive planning. Some, including panelists, disagreed, emphasizing that data and modeling are tools that support, but do not replace, human expertise. Human ingenuity remains essential for considering anatomical nuances and managing complex cases. While AI may help with routine procedures in the future, it relies on data quality and lacks adaptability in unexpected situations.  A Range of Solutions in 3D Printing The future will reveal the extent to which human expertise is supplemented or replaced by technology, but for now, many companies are making advances in 3D printing for health care.  Examples include: - ETH Zurich and Strait Access Technologies: Initial tests of 3D-printed silicone heart valves. - Dr. Matthew Griffith (University of Sydney): Designed a 3D-printed retina made of carbon, with clinical trials anticipated soon. - Monogram Orthopedics (U.S.): Developing knee replacements customized to each patient’s anatomy, aiming for reduced pain and lower failure rates. - North Carolina State University: Created textile-based cartilage implants from patient stem cells, successfully tested in dogs with hip issues.  From silicone and cartilage to metal, the ability to create personalized implants on-site and deliver them promptly to clinicians—alongside advances in telehealth and genetics—is set to revolutionize health care.  In summary, the medical community is increasingly focusing on personalized treatment to achieve better outcomes for patients. Leveraging innovative planning and manufacturing technologies, stakeholders from device companies to hospital systems are embracing patient-specific approaches to care.
translated_content: Bryan Crutchfield est vice-président et directeur général pour l’Amérique du Nord chez Materialise, un leader mondial de l’impression 3D.  La personnalisation est une tendance émergente dans de nombreux secteurs, des applications personnalisables sur nos appareils aux constructeurs automobiles proposant différents niveaux de finition et options logicielles. Dans le domaine de la santé, la personnalisation peut même sauver des vies. Comme chaque patient est unique, les solutions universelles peuvent s’avérer inefficaces, menant parfois à des taux de réussite moindres ou à des consultations répétées et coûteuses.  Grâce aux technologies avancées de planification et de fabrication, les cliniciens peuvent désormais offrir des soins personnalisés, avec un potentiel d’amélioration des résultats et de sauvetage de vies. Cela marque une transition vers la personnalisation de masse et les traitements sur mesure.  Formes de personnalisation dans les soins de santé La personnalisation en santé prend de multiples formes, qu’il s’agisse de permettre aux patients de choisir entre des rendez-vous en présentiel ou virtuels, ou d’utiliser des informations génétiques pour orienter les traitements. Par exemple, les tests génétiques peuvent aider les médecins à repérer les patients prédisposés à certaines maladies. Par ailleurs, des technologies comme l’impression 3D facilitent la planification des interventions médicales et la création d’implants sur mesure pour remplacer des tissus ou des os manquants.  De nombreuses entreprises œuvrent dans le secteur de la personnalisation de masse afin d’améliorer les résultats pour les patients avec des solutions aussi uniques que chaque individu.  Tendances et perspectives pour la personnalisation de masse L’an dernier, mon entreprise a organisé un événement réunissant des cliniciens, des chercheurs et des experts de sociétés de dispositifs médicaux pour discuter des opportunités et des défis de la personnalisation de masse en médecine. La majorité des participants (89 %) ont estimé que cette technologie deviendrait la norme ou serait durablement adoptée dans les dix prochaines années.  De plus, plus de 95 % considéraient que l’impression 3D au point de soins représente une opportunité majeure, notamment pour la planification des procédures. L’intégration de l’impression 3D dans les établissements de santé fait de plus en plus partie des stratégies des fabricants de dispositifs médicaux.  Un peu plus de 70 % des participants pensent que, dans dix ans, les données, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et la modélisation statistique de formes dépasseront l’humain dans la planification prédictive. Certains, notamment des panélistes, ne partagent pas cet avis et rappellent que ces outils sont des supports mais ne remplacent pas l’expertise humaine. L’ingéniosité humaine reste essentielle pour tenir compte des nuances anatomiques et gérer les cas complexes. L’IA pourrait aider dans des procédures de routine à l’avenir, mais elle dépend de la qualité des données et ne sait pas s’adapter aux situations imprévues.  Un éventail de solutions en impression 3D L’avenir dira dans quelle mesure l’expertise humaine sera complétée ou remplacée par la technologie, mais aujourd’hui, de nombreuses entreprises réalisent des avancées en matière d’impression 3D appliquée à la santé.  Exemples : - ETH Zurich et Strait Access Technologies : premiers tests de valves cardiaques en silicone imprimées en 3D. - Dr Matthew Griffith (Université de Sydney) : conception d’une rétine imprimée en 3D à base de carbone, avec des essais cliniques prévus prochainement. - Monogram Orthopedics (États-Unis) : développement de prothèses de genou adaptées à l’anatomie de chaque patient, visant à réduire la douleur et les échecs. - Université d’État de Caroline du Nord : fabrication d’implants cartilagineux textiles à partir de cellules souches de patients, testés avec succès chez des chiens atteints de problèmes de hanches.  Du silicone au cartilage en passant par le métal, la capacité à créer des implants personnalisés sur place et à les fournir rapidement aux cliniciens—ainsi que les progrès en télémédecine et génétique—promet de transformer les soins de santé.  En résumé, le secteur médical se concentre de plus en plus sur les traitements personnalisés pour de meilleurs résultats. En s’appuyant sur des technologies innovantes de planification et de fabrication, tous les acteurs, des fabricants d’équipements aux hôpitaux, adoptent une approche centrée sur le patient.

article_content: Daniel, the beagle mix who won over the hearts of people nationwide after surviving a gas chamber in Alabama, will be honored with his own float in the Rose Parade in Pasadena, California. As a six-month-old puppy, Daniel was among 18 dogs placed in a steel chamber filled with carbon monoxide in Florence, Alabama. Against all odds, he survived and wagged his tail when the ordeal ended. Now two years old and known for his joyful personality, Daniel was adopted by Joe Dwyer—a motivational speaker from Nutley, New Jersey—after his remarkable story received national attention. Dwyer has praised Daniel’s resilient and upbeat attitude, crediting him with inspiring reforms. Daniel’s experience has contributed to stronger animal welfare laws in 31 states, aiming to ban inhumane euthanasia in shelters. During the historic Rose Parade, Daniel will participate alongside seven other dogs, performing his 'high five to keep pets alive' routine. Their float, sponsored by the Lucy Pet Foundation—which provides mobile spay, neuter, and adoption services—will promote humane treatment and adoption of shelter animals. As a 'spokesdog,' Daniel represents the Foundation’s mission. The parade, a tradition watched by hundreds of thousands each New Year’s Day, will help raise awareness about animal compassion and the importance of adopting shelter pets.

article_content: Matthew Atherton, aged 23, and Anne Turnbull, aged 30, appeared at Preston Crown Court charged with child neglect following the death of their baby son, Liam. During a night of heavy drinking with friends in their Blackburn home, the couple left four-month-old Liam, who was suffering from a cold, unattended in a cold downstairs room with the back door open. As Atherton, Turnbull, and their guests consumed large amounts of alcohol, Liam’s health deteriorated. Despite requests from guests to call for medical help after Liam suffered a seizure, Atherton and Turnbull did not seek assistance. The following morning, Turnbull discovered Liam unresponsive in his moses basket. He was transported to hospital but was pronounced dead soon after. Police investigations revealed significant alcohol consumption in the house, and tests showed Atherton was three times the legal drinking limit at the time Liam was found. Authorities confirmed social services had previously provided support to the family. The parents pleaded guilty to child neglect and await sentencing on June 21. The coroner ruled pneumonia as Liam’s cause of death. Officials and community members expressed deep sadness and concern, and the local council pledged full cooperation with the ongoing investigation.

article_content: During a White House summit on working families focusing on work-life balance, recent research was recalled challenging the view that balancing work and home life is mainly a women's issue. A Pew Research Center survey found 56% of working mothers and 50% of working fathers find it very or somewhat difficult to balance work and family responsibilities. Another national survey by Flex+Strategy Group/Work+Life Fit Inc. revealed that more men than women are telecommuting: nearly one-third of full-time workers do most of their work remotely, and almost 75% of those are men. This matters because policymakers and media often discuss work-life balance as primarily a concern for women, particularly working mothers. Cali Yost, CEO of Flex+Strategy Group/Work+Life Fit Inc., states the research shows our thinking about work-life flexibility does not match reality, and that both organizations and individuals miss out on benefits as a result. Stereotypes held by top executives may limit how far companies are willing to go to promote workplace flexibility. A review of nearly 4,000 executive interviews by Harvard Business School students found both male and female executives largely see work-family tension as a woman's problem. Writers Jessica Grose (Slate) and Rebecca Traister (New Republic) argue the conversation needs to focus on work-life balance as an issue for everyone, not just women. Craig Cincotta, Vice President at Porch.com, and Jennifer Styles, co-owner of The Workshop Collective, emphasize that work-life balance concerns both genders, parents and non-parents alike. Cincotta notes that, in today’s always-connected world, people feel pressured to be accessible at all times, making healthy work-life balance harder to achieve. Styles adds that even non-parents in leadership roles feel guilty when not always available for their teams. Some believe organizational commitment to flexibility may be weakening. After Yahoo! CEO Marissa Mayer banned remote work, some feared other companies would follow. According to a Flex+Strategy Group/Work+Life Fit Inc. survey, while 97% reported some flexibility at work, over 40% felt their company’s commitment to flexibility was decreasing. Only 40% of those with flexibility received guidance on how to use it effectively. Yost argues that most workers with flexibility are not taking full advantage because of lack of instruction, leading to losses for both employees and organizations. Cincotta believes there is no universal solution for work-life balance; everyone needs to find their own approach, whether that's remote work one day a week or choosing not to check email on weekends. Broadening the discussion to include men and non-parents can inspire positive workplace change and create more opportunities for all employees. Amy Glazer of San Jose State University says splitting child-rearing duties with a partner enabled her and her spouse to balance their careers with parenting responsibilities.
